title: Run the platform performance smoke test
caption: tools/perf/README.md 'Run it'. Scratch stack only, never the VM or the velexis database; nothing else may run (it measures this machine).

steps.title: Scratch database and Redis
steps.body: Create `velexis_perf_<ts>` as `velexis_test_admin` with the bootstrap grants, `schemas.sql`, `pnpm db:migrate`, `pnpm db:seed:reference`; a private `redis-server --port 6390`.

steps.title: Start API and worker like systemd
steps.body: Env file from `deploy/env/platform-backend.env.example` + local lines; `NODE_OPTIONS` from `node tools/perf/unit-node-options.mjs deploy/systemd/<unit>.service`; preload `tools/perf/gc-observer.cjs`.

steps.title: Measure
steps.body: `node tools/perf/platform-smoke.mjs --base http://127.0.0.1:3100 --duration 10` (or the 60 s recorded run with `--json` and the GC logs).
steps.expect: Exit 0: every p95 target met (reads < 300 ms, signIn < 800 ms, cached ask < 20 ms), RSS within MemoryMax with ≥ 64 MiB headroom, GC ≤ 5 %.

steps.title: Clean up
steps.body: Stop the processes, `redis-cli -p 6390 -a dev_redis shutdown nosave`, `DROP DATABASE velexis_perf_<ts> WITH (FORCE)`.
